The State of Greater Lebanon ( Arabic : دولة لبنان الكبير , romanized : Dawlat Lubnān al-Kabīr ; French : État du Grand Liban ), informally known as French Lebanon , was a state declared on 1 September 1920, which became the Lebanese Republic (Arabic: الجمهورية اللبنانية , romanized: al-Jumhūriyyah al-Lubnāniyyah ; French: République libanaise ) in May 1926, and is the predecessor of modern Lebanon .
